propositions: rebar's bedrock provider ignores AWS_REGION environment variable (the standard modern AWS tooling default) and only consults REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, causing LLM operations to fail unless one of those is explicitly set
boto3 session region resolution via botocore does not consult AWS_REGION, so rebar must resolve the chain itself and pass region_name explicitly to bypass botocore's quirk
provenance records for bedrock provider runs must capture both the resolved region value and its source (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, or AWS_REGION)
the resolution order must follow strict precedence: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION (config) > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > boto3 profile fallback, with empty-string env vars treated as unset
error messages and docs must name the full resolution chain and no longer incorrectly state that AWS_REGION alone cannot resolve
region and region_source fields are added to provider provenance when bedrock's resolution chain yields a result, and omitted when only boto3's ambient profile resolution applies
